text:
Sophie (AE): Heads-up — our Boardroom POC is at final signoff. CISO wants explicit confirmation on KMS/HSM posture, egress controls, and a tight committed-capacity pricing example for CFO. Need an internal exec-ready summary by EOD.

Raj (SE): On KMS — we can support customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-KMS) with AWS KMS / GCP CMEK. For on-prem we offer HSM integration via PKCS#11. I can draft the tech note.

Maria (Security): @Raj please include key rotation policy, access audit logs, and where the key material is stored (control plane vs customer vault). Also need to confirm we do not cache plaintext keys anywhere. :lock:

Leo (Infra): For egress, they asked about IP allowlist + egress-only VPC endpoints. We can provide dedicated peering + static egress NAT; need their ASN and CIDR ranges. Also can support forced-tunnel if they require egress inspection.

Sophie (AE): Good — can you both bullet the answers so I can paste into the executive brief? CFO specifically wants a committed monthly pricing example for 10M tokens + 2 dedicated GPUs for peak.

Raj (SE): Draft pricing: hosted baseline + reserved capacity discount model. Example: Hosted usage 10M tokens = $X, Dedicated reserve for 2x A100-equivalent = $Y/month committed (includes 20% discount vs on-demand). I'll pull exact numbers from pricing sheet and attach.

Alex (Legal): Contract asks: they want a clause for key custody escalation and audit rights. We can offer SOC2 attestation + optional right-to-audit under enterprise addendum. Need Sales to confirm desired scope of audit and data residency.

Maria (Security): Also: we need to run their standard security questionnaire — share the doc and I'll queue the answers. If they require a penetration test, we coordinate windows and plan.

Sophie (AE): They sent a short questionnaire (attached in customer email). I'll drop it here. Can we confirm timeline: exec brief by 17:00 PT and a one-page tech appendix?

Raj (SE): Yes. I'll put together the tech appendix: KMS integration, key lifecycle, HSM notes, IP/peering config snippet.

Leo (Infra): I'll provide the network diagram and the egress NAT pattern + sample firewall rules. Example snippet for the peer config:```peer-asn: 65001
peer-cidr: 10.10.0.0/24
bgp-md5: enabled
allowed-egress-cidrs: [203.0.113.0/24]```

Maria (Security): For the audit trail: we log all KMS envelope operations to customer-controlled CloudTrail/Splunk. Add that note.

deploy-bot: Deployment window placeholder created for "boardroom-poc" on 2024-06-05T22:00Z - assigned to @Leo (Infra).

Sophie (AE): @Alex can you confirm if the audit clause language below is ok for an exec summary? "Redwood allows audit access under a mutually-agreed enterprise addendum; we provide SOC2 reports and coordinate targeted audits under NDA."

Alex (Legal): That language is fine for the brief. For contract negotiations we'll need a more detailed SOW and A&A scope.

Sophie (AE): Action items: Raj = tech appendix + committed pricing example (EOD). Leo = network diagram + sample configs (EOD). Maria = questionnaire answers + audit note (EOD). Alex = confirm legal blurb and flag any non-standard asks. I'll assemble brief and loop in the VP.

Raj (SE): Got it. I'll upload the appendix to the thread when ready.

Leo (Infra): Copy. Will include peering SLA expectations and fallback (VPN) details.

Maria (Security): Copy — I'll mark any item that needs additional controls.

Sophie (AE): Thanks team :raised_hands: — if we hit any blocker escalate to me immediately, I'll follow up with customer execs.

Raj (SE): Quick Q — does the customer require HSM-backed key wrapping only, or full in-HSM encryption? I can tailor the wording.

Sophie (AE): They're asking for HSM-backed wrapping (BYOK) for model keys, not full disk encryption. I'll confirm and post update.

Alex (Legal): One more: they requested a 30-day termination clause for the trial. Standard trial language is fine but add a 3-day notice for scheduled maintenance exceptions.

Sophie (AE): Noted. I'll include that in the exec brief. Final: I'll ping VP at 16:30 PT with draft.

deploy-bot: Note: resource reservation created for "boardroom-poc" (2 GPU units) — reservation ID res-0a1b2c3d.
